notes.title: Gallery of Things: Reveries - Available NOW!
notes.notes:
Dive into a Dadaist journey, unraveling nature and technology mysteries in 36 captivating levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780286/4492cefa782ae937f4f8e791cfb8d5097df99e34.gif[/img]

"Gallery of Things: Reveries" is a unique hidden object game deeply influenced by the whimsical and thought-provoking Dadaism art movement. Spanning 36 levels, each stage is meticulously crafted to be a visual and intellectual challenge. Players are immersed in montages that blend the surreal with the familiar, urging a deeper contemplation of the interplay between humans, nature, and technology. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780286/d2f50edfcb12d294f94e68f6374282da8de370cb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44780286/a75bbb827cc623cab7f17407546e659c31e2afea.png[/img]

This game is more than just a search-and-find challenge; it's an artistic journey that captivates the mind and stirs the soul.
